phase: P9 nation-resource bridge contract (simulated provider only)
contract: Observation receives the persisted transfer and APPLY/COMPENSATE direction.
Exact durable receipts bind key, source, target, resource, amount, APPLIED status, category, description and authority domain.
Transport APPLIED/ALREADY_APPLIED responses require a fresh matching durable receipt.
Unknown, missing or conflicting evidence never authorizes a write.
Explicit NOT_APPLIED proof guarantees no previous attempt can complete later.
Provider ID includes all 256 authority-domain digest bits; changing ledgers rejects old saga plans.
Malformed UTF-16 identifiers are rejected before hashing or provider access.
Apply and compensation recover after the external effect succeeds but journal cursor persistence fails, without duplicate balance changes.
Spent resources leave compensation in review until an authoritative query and later retry can recover them.
remaining_requirements: Pinned released upstream API and a real bridge implementation
Initiator/nation authorization and authenticated business entry points
Owner-thread and atomic authority-domain enforcement in the upstream ledger
Production receipt durability, provider reconciliation and operator recovery
Cross-server coordination and real-server failure acceptance
